route.rationale: Bounded deterministic resource-control correction with a precise enumeration loop and deterministic test oracle; the lease does not alter the F_GETPATH architecture.

candidate.artifact_set_formula: Sort source and test artifacts by path; for each concatenate path, one TAB, lowercase SHA-256 without prefix, and one LF; SHA-256 the resulting bytes.

changes.result: Added a 256-entry and 64-KiB name-byte cap for each exact-name scan plus a 4096-entry and 1-MiB name-byte cap shared by every scan in one read operation. Budget exhaustion returns the existing content-free ResourceLimit failure after close, never a partial EntryMatch.

One EnumerationBudget is created per read_file and is passed to ancestor pre-open and post-open checks, leaf pre-read and post-read checks, reverse attachment revalidation, and final present/absent Apple exact-name checks.

Added exact-limit, one-over, late-alias, cumulative scan, bounded churn, byte-cap, filesystem repeated-ancestor, and Darwin churn controls; added the non-Apple descriptor-path UnsupportedHost unit control.

per_scan.completion_behavior: One additional readdir call may observe EOF or the first over-limit entry; then the scan completes or returns ResourceLimit.

per_read_operation.scan_sites: Every exact_entry call is budgeted; canonical path depth is already bounded at 16, so read_file has at most 48 exact-name scan sites.

resource_budget.stopping: No retry, polling, or partial-success path is added. A stream that continues past either bound terminates with ResourceLimit.
